dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Mr King was surrendered to the care center by his previous owner due to their housing situation. His previous owners describe him as an active, playful, and affectionate dog. During his time at the care center, Mr. King has shown some fearful and defensive behavior, in one case escalating to snapping at handlers during medical examination, and increasing arousal, which has resulted in Mr King jumping on a handler and biting their hand in an attempt to access treats, a bite and release that resulted in three shallow puncture wounds. Due to this, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based), and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Mr. King
